segment.source: Renders tiles of deliberately unequal size on one grid, so the leading entry can take a double cell and the rest fall in around it. Use it for: product overview bands where one capability leads, platform pages with a headline feature, marketing pages that want a composed rather than a regular rhythm. Prefer 'Feature Grid' when every entry carries the same weight, and 'Feature Showcase Row' when the leading capability deserves a whole band of its own.
